prompt: Quote Article 1 of the Egyptian Civil Code exactly as it is written.
gold: Provisions of laws govern all matters to which these provisions apply in letter or spirit. prompt: Quote Article 280 of the Egyptian Civil Code exactly as it is written.

pred: If a creditor releases one of the joint and several debtors from the joint and several liability, his right to claim the whole of the debt from the other co-debtors remains unless otherwise agreed.

prompt: Quote Article 1068 of the Egyptian Civil Code exactly as it is written.
gold: The application shall be made by a summons to the third party holder and to the former owner, signed by the applicant or his representative holding a special mandate for this purpose.
